units.logical_version_count: accepted ordinal Git versions, not deployments
units.rpki_source_rows: original scoped CSV authorization rows, not operator actions
units.rpki_transition_tuples: derived canonical additions/removals, not native commands
units.dns_address_groups: qualified four-field daily observed address groups
units.dns_descriptive_value_differences: observed value-set difference, not authoritative configuration edit
units.ris_native_occurrences: peer-prefix source-coordinate events; preserve distinct equal-looking payloads
units.kafka_serialized_value_bytes: ACK-bound value bytes, not network wire bytes
units.parquet_physical_bytes: file or object content bytes, not backend filesystem overhead
units.checkpoint_allocated_bytes: filesystem allocated bytes only if measured; else NOT_MEASURED
units.elapsed_wall_seconds: specified boundaries; never callback-only time relabeled all-in
units.accepted_logical_occurrences_per_second: distinct RIS IDs / stream-ready to final validated commit incl drain
units.source_time_occurrences_per_second: historical hour occurrence count / 3600 source seconds, not achieved throughput
units.drain_ratio: post-producer to final validated commit seconds / producer seconds
units.worker_core_logical_rows_per_second: Per-role exact IDs /measurement after client,input,verifier setup through verifiedcompletion and guardshutdown;notprocessstartup or H3acceptedrate

forbidden: Spark input chunks/s relabeled native events/s
unmeasured: NOT_MEASURED, NOT_RUN or N/A, never invented zero
